title: Stop clicking the address bar! Do this instead ⚡ #Shorts
description:
Want to type a new web address or search fast? Hold Ctrl and press L, and your cursor jumps straight to the address bar with the text selected.

⌨️ Windows: Ctrl + L
🍎 Mac: Cmd + L

Works in Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari. Alt + D also works on Windows browsers.

A new life-saving tip every day, in 15 seconds. Save this for later and subscribe 🔔
